projects.title: Weather Station with Wireless Logging
bullets: Logged BME280 data every minute for 30 days over Wi-Fi and lost under 1% of samples
Wrote a C calibration routine checked against a reference thermometer at 20 points, to within 0.5 °C
Wrote a Python plotting script that flagged gaps over 5 minutes and found 3 Wi-Fi outages

projects.title: 4-Bit ALU on a Breadboard
bullets: Built a 4-bit ALU out of 14 74HC-series chips that can add, subtract, AND, OR and XOR, and checked it against a Logisim model for all 256 input pairs of each operation with DIP switches and LEDs
Found 2 wiring faults in the carry chain by probing each stage with a logic analyzer

experience.title: Electrical Lead
bullets: Designed and soldered a 2-layer power distribution board in KiCad with 6 fused outputs to replace the old hand-wired harness, so wiring before a match takes 45 minutes instead of 3 hours
Traced controller resets on hard turns to a 1.2 V dip on the 5 V rail with an oscilloscope and gave the controller its own 5 V regulator, with no resets in the 12 matches since the change
